title: Administration-Fee Courtesy for Self-Help Charges (Community Rules & Site Care Resident Terms)
content:
An administration-fee courtesy is taken off the administration fee of a self-help charge under Community Rules & Site Care. It turns on tenure, counted in whole calendar months from the move-in date on the Home-Site Lease to the handling date, and on returned payments on the Home-Site Lease ledger within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date:

- 50% of the administration fee with at least 120 months of tenure and no returned payment;
- 25% of the administration fee when that does not hold but the resident has at least 60 months of tenure and at most one returned payment;
- nothing otherwise.

The courtesy is taken off the administration fee alone; the contractor's cost is not reduced.

## Combinations

| Tenure (whole calendar months) | Returned payments in the 12 months | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| 120 or more | none | 50% |
| 120 or more | one | 25% |
| 120 or more | two or more | none |
| 60 to 119 | none or one | 25% |
| 60 to 119 | two or more | none |
| fewer than 60 | any | none |

## Hypothetical illustration

An administration fee of $45.00: a 50% courtesy takes $22.50 off, leaving $22.50; a 25% courtesy takes $11.25 off, leaving $33.75.
